message.content: {"hts_code": "7117.19.9000", "reason": "The earrings are imitation jewelry of materials other than base metal (baked polymer clay), with minor plated stainless steel components, classified in the residual provision of subheading 7117.19."}
message.reasoning: Earrings of polymer clay — imitation jewelry, other than base metal? Polymer clay not precious. 7117.19 or 7117.49? Base metal whether or not plated with precious metal — 7117.19.9000? Actually 7117.19 covers of base metal whether or not plated with precious metal. But polymer clay is not base metal... earrings of polymer clay with base metal parts. Likely 7117.19.9000.
